name: shlink
title: Shlink
description: Shlink is a URL shortener with visit statistics, QR codes and an API, plus the web client to manage links in the browser. Set the short domain (behind Traefik: shlink.<your domain>); the web client opens pre-connected to this server.

variables.name: PORT_SHLINK
variables.label: API / short-link port
variables.description: Host port for api / short-link port

variables.name: PORT_SHLINK_WEB
variables.label: Web client port
variables.description: Host port for web client port

variables.name: SHLINK_DOMAIN
variables.label: Short domain
variables.description: Domain short links are built on, e.g. s.example.com (without https://)

variables.name: SHLINK_HTTPS
variables.label: Served over HTTPS
variables.description: true when Traefik terminates TLS for the short domain

variables.name: SHLINK_PUBLIC_URL
variables.label: API URL for the web client
variables.description: What the browser uses to reach the Shlink API (the short domain with its scheme)

variables.name: SHLINK_INITIAL_API_KEY
variables.label: API key
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one; it is also pre-filled in the web client
